title: High-performance anode material for Li-ion batteries from bismuth molybdate incorporating F-free binder
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8772-8780
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09474G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
To Giang Tran, Thuy-An Nguyen, Viet Duc Phung, Dinh Quan Nguyen, Thanh Ngoc Nguyen, Dang Manh Le, Hieu Trung Bui, Il Tae Kim, Tran Thi Kieu Ngan, Tuan Loi Nguyen
A polycrystalline bismuth molybdate nanomaterial was synthesized using a simple method at low calcination temperatures and combined with a poly(acrylic acid) binder to create a high-performance and environmentally friendly anode for Li-ion battery.
